description: This Java source file defines the ApkCheck class, which is responsible for analyzing Android APK files against the published API specifications. It includes functionalities for parsing XML API description files, expanding class inheritance hierarchies, and checking for API compatibility issues such as illegal references, missing classes, or deprecated items. The program's main entry point processes command-line arguments, reads API descriptions, and performs checks across multiple APKs, producing warnings and errors based on the findings.

classes.name: ApkCheck
classes.description: Main class for performing API checks on Android APK files against a public API specification. Contains logic for parsing, analysis, and reporting of incompatibilities.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Program entry point that processes command-line arguments, loads API descriptions, and performs checks on specified APK files.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the ApkCheck tool.

methods.name: parseApiDescr
methods.description: Loads and parses an API description XML file into an ApiList object.

methods.name: parseXml
methods.description: Parses an XML API description file and populates the ApiList with its contents.

methods.name: flattenInherited
methods.description: Expands class hierarchies within the ApiList to include inherited methods and fields for accurate API analysis.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Compares the APK API description against the public API to identify mismatches, missing classes, or invalid references.

methods.name: apkWarning
methods.description: Outputs a warning message regarding an APK compatibility issue, if warnings are enabled.

methods.name: apkError
methods.description: Outputs an error message regarding an APK incompatibility or violation, if errors are enabled.
